summary: LedgerSMB is a self-hosted accounting and enterprise resource planning system tailored for small and midsize businesses. It provides double-entry accounting alongside core modules for managing invoicing, orders, inventory, budgeting, and project tracking. The platform is written in Perl and distributed under the GPL-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you need a comprehensive, open-source ERP system for financial and inventory management and prefer a self-hosted Perl stack.
watchOut: The project has a moderate maintenance profile and a smaller community footprint than some mainstream alternatives, which may affect how quickly you find troubleshooting support. Customising or maintaining a Perl-based codebase can also require niche administrative skills.
deployNotes: As it is packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your database and application data, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
